title: Genesis 22:15-16 letter grid: "sha" (שה, lamb) found lower in the column
summary: The Genesis 22:15-16 letter grid with a gold box around another vertical pair, ה over ש, lower down in the same column. The gold labels "sha", שה and "Lamb" move down to the right, level with that pair. Gold-coloured letters mark the earlier pairs.

pictures.description: Grid of Hebrew letters (the text of Genesis 22:15-16 in rows) with purple מלאך, coloured letters of יהוה, a blue diagonal box, a tall red box around a column, a green row box, and a gold box around a vertical pair of letters in a lower row plus gold-coloured letters elsewhere.

uncertain: Dense letter grid not copied cell by cell; only the highlighted letters and labels are transcribed.
